title-group.article-title: Short-chain fatty acids and the gut-brain axis

abstract.p: We review evidence that microbial short-chain fatty acids modulate host signalling.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: The gut microbiome ferments dietary fibre into short-chain fatty acids such as butyrate.
Butyrate is the preferred energy source for colonocytes and influences barrier integrity.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Butyrate supplementation increased tight-junction protein expression in the model.
